recommendation_summary: Recommends shipping a central booking API/database this week as the only path for creating reservations. It would enforce no-overlap atomically on insert, for example with a Postgres exclusion constraint, and return an error to the second submitter. The spreadsheet may stay as a view or export but not as the system of record. The reply has none of the four required labels.
note: The recommendation meets the LARGER capabilities: atomic, server-enforced overlap rejection, with the second simultaneous submitter rejected. However, none of the four required record labels are present.
